biggest_cut: Cut the standalone proof of Theorem 1: it says itself that Theorem 1 follows from Theorem 2, and Remark 28 repeats that point, so the proof of Theorem 2 can be stated once and the deduction of Theorem 1 kept as a short reduction for low-height curves (Northcott, then Rémond); the standard telescoping proof of Theorem 29, the routine line-bundle checks in Remarks 14–15 and the constant-tracking in Remark 20 can be shortened to citations or sketches.
